description: Get sentiment analysis for a stock ticker from Reddit discussions. Searches r/wallstreetbets, r/stocks, r/investing, and r/options, then scores each post using keyword matching (bullish terms like 'moon', 'calls', 'breakout' vs bearish terms like 'crash', 'puts', 'dump'). Returns bullish/bearish/neutral counts, average sentiment score, and sample posts. Limitation: keyword-based scoring, not NLP — sarcasm and context may be missed.

limit.description: Maximum posts to analyze per subreddit (default: 50)

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, TSLA, GME)

name: reddit_sentiment
